resources.string: Offline demo · Messages stay on this device and reset when the app restarts.
Could you add a reading mode? It would help on longer articles.
Thanks for the idea! Reading mode is included in this update. Let us know how it feels.

## A little more room to read

A calmer reading experience, and a simpler way to stay in touch.

- **Reading mode** gives longer articles room to breathe.
- **Send feedback** without leaving the app, with screenshots and files.
- **Your conversations** keep every reply in one place.

### Made better together

Thank you for every thoughtful suggestion. Your feedback helps shape what comes next.
